NONE: › the scientific study of people and their working conditions, especially done in order to improve effectiveness
（尤指旨在提高效率的）人類工程學，人體工學，工效學

example: A specialist in ergonomics will work with the team designing the production line in our new factory.
一位工效學專家將與這個團隊一起工作來設計我們新工廠的生產線。
The ergonomics of the new office furniture have reduced eyestrain and back problems among the computer users.
新辦公傢俱的設計安裝運用了人體工學原理，緩解了電腦使用者的視覺疲勞和背部病症的問題。
